description: Use for 'can I, as a citizen of X, get this Polystate service' — e.g. 'can a US citizen buy Paraguay Temporary Residence'. Give `nationality` (ISO-3166 code or English name) and the `service` id or name as returned by list_services (case, accents and hyphens are ignored). Returns the service's formal requirements and whether any nationality restriction applies; services are treated as eligible until a structured restriction is recorded. A partial or ambiguous name returns candidates instead of guessing. Free: never consumes quota.

nationality.description: Applicant's nationality: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'US', 'USA', 'United States'.

service.description: Service name or id exactly as returned by list_services, e.g. 'Paraguay Temporary Residence'.

name: check_eligibility
title: Check eligibility for a service
